name: تحويل الملي ثانية إلى ساعات ودقائق وثواني
description: بناء برنامج يستخرج الساعات والدقائق والثواني من مقدار من الزمن بالملي ثانية.
code:
#Khutwa 1: Qiraat al-millisaniya
text = input("adkhil al-millisaniya: ")
milliseconds = int(text)
#Khutwa 2: Istikhraaj al-saeat, al-daqaeq, wa al-thawani min al-millisaniya
total_secs = milliseconds // 1000
hours = total_secs // 3600
mins = ( total_secs // 60 ) % 60
secs = total_secs % 60
#Khutwa 3: Ard al-nateeja
print(milliseconds, "al-millisaniya hiya", hours, "saeat wa" , mins , "daqaeq wa" , secs , "thawani.")

untr_name: Converting Milliseconds to Hours-Minutes- and Seconds
untr_description: Construct a program that obtains hours, minutes, and seconds from an amount of time in milliseconds.
untr_code:
#Step 1: Read the milliseconds
text = input("Enter the milliseconds: ")
milliseconds = int(text)
#Step 2: Obtain hours, minutes, and seconds from the milliseconds
total_secs = milliseconds // 1000
hours = total_secs // 3600
mins = ( total_secs // 60 ) % 60
secs = total_secs % 60
#Step 3: Display the result
print(milliseconds, "milliseconds is", hours, "hours and" , mins , "minutes and" , secs , "seconds.")
